offerings.name: Web Search API (/search)
offerings.pricing: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results, rounded up per 10 results (e.g., 11 results = 4 credits). Credits shared across all endpoints. Pay-as-you-go adds credits in 5 USD increments (e.g., Standard: 2,000 credits per $5). Plans: Free $0/1,000 credits; Hobby $16/mo (annual) 5,000 credits; Standard $83/mo (annual) 100,000 credits; Growth $333/mo 500,000; Scale $599/mo 1,000,000.
offerings.price_basis: Standard plan pay-as-you-go ($5 per 2,000 credits, 2 credits = 1 search of 10 results)
offerings.free_quota: 1,000 credits every month refreshed monthly, no credit card required; covers 500 searches; Scrape/Search/Interact also work keyless with per-IP daily caps
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果（返回 titles, descriptions, and URLs，可加 scrapeOptions 取每个结果的全文 markdown/HTML/截图；支持 web/news/images 源与 research/pdf/developer 类别）
offerings.note: ZDR search: end-to-end ZDR 10 credits per 10 results（企业参数）; anonymized ZDR 2 credits per 10 results. X.com URLs 走 Grok API，+29 credits/request。搜索含 Highlights 默认开启。
